description: This is a PHP class file defining the Manufacturer model within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It contains methods for retrieving manufacturer data from the database, including individual manufacturers, list of manufacturers, and layout information.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Model class for handling manufacturer data, provides methods such as getManufacturer, getManufacturers, and getLayoutId.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a single manufacturer based on its ID.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers, optionally sorted and paginated.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a manufacturer.
